components.name: LayoutCanvas
components.summary: Schematic freeform layout canvas with Media/Catalog and five information components, movement and eight resize handles.
components.usage: Compose inside the authorized Layout editor, or omit callbacks for a read-only preview. The feature owns drafts, permission checks, history, area limits, catalog bindings and persistence. Reuse Button and TextField around this domain-specific canvas; DataSet remains the layout overview. Widget faces are illustrative; authenticated live previews belong to the inspector. Clock playback uses screen offsets rather than the browser preview time.
components.accessibility: Each editable area is a native labeled button with pressed selection and visible focus. Arrow keys move by ten canvas units; Shift with arrow keys resizes. The editor supplies equivalent add, select, split and numeric controls for keyboard and touch users. Pointer geometry stays within canvas bounds. Preview colors represent screen content; surrounding controls inherit the product theme.

props.name: name, canvas, areas
props.meaning: Layout label, canonical orientation size and freeform rectangles with kind, color and stacking order.

props.name: selected, flagged
props.meaning: Selected editor identity and validation issue indices.

props.name: onSelect, onMove
props.meaning: Feature-owned selection and geometry updates; omit for read-only rendering.

props.name: onGestureStart, onGestureEnd
props.meaning: Bracket one pointer gesture so undo restores the whole movement or resize.

props.name: dragging, onInsert
props.meaning: Only an active, feature-owned component drag with the matching internal MIME payload may insert. The feature enforces the area limit.

examples.label: Layout editor canvas
examples.description: Feature-owned schematic composition; no live authenticated requests.
examples.code: <LayoutCanvas name={draft.name} canvas={layout.canvas} areas={draft.areas} selected={selected} onSelect={setSelected} onMove={moveArea} />

components.name: WidgetSettings
components.summary: Feature-owned configuration and explicit source previews for the five layout widgets.
components.usage: Use only inside an authorized layout draft. Reuses TextField/Button and branch choices; the API remains authoritative for scope, validation, provider access and publish-only QR activation.
components.accessibility: Labeled native controls support keyboard input. Canvas content has no interactive descendants. Provider status is explicit, source text is rendered as text, and ticker animation respects reduced-motion preferences.
